justification: The ghost reconstructs the original's core semantic claim with high fidelity despite substantial rewording. Original: 'the golden rule of self-similarity - the only good is the good of the whole' maps to ghost's 'simply saying serve the whole'. Original: 'whoever defines the whole defines the good' maps to 'the one who gets to draw the line around what counts as the whole thereby decides what counts as good'. Original: 'no node adjudicates the boundary of the whole alone' maps to 'no single part may settle, on its own, where the boundary of the whole lies'. Original: 'The whole is always checked from outside' maps to 'That call always comes from beyond the part making it'. Original: 'This is the law that keeps the first from becoming a license' maps to 'Without this companion, the first principle could be turned into a permission slip'. Original: 'it is ratified, not provisional' maps to 'this partner law is settled, not still open'. The semantic structure is intact: premise about the seam in the golden rule, diagnosis of the flaw (self-definition of boundaries), the co-equal law as remedy, its necessity as constraint against abuse, and its permanent status. No claims are inverted, dropped, or invented.
